articles.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that Rick Matros, the company’s Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Costa, the company’s Chief Financial Officer, Darrin Smith, the company’s Chief Investment Officer, and Lukas Hartwich, the company’s Executive Vice President of Finance, will attend Wells Fargo’s 29 th Annual Real Estate Securities Conference on May 4 – May 6, 2026, at The Charleston Place in Charleston, South Carolina.
